title: SerialBot — let your AI agent use the serial port
description: A lightweight serial, TCP and UDP debugging tool with a built-in MCP server. Your AI agent flashes the board, reads the log and debugs on its own; you approve what it does.
hero_title: Let the agent read the serial port itself.
hero_lede: SerialBot is a small serial, TCP and UDP debugging tool for Windows, macOS and Linux with a built-in MCP server. Your AI agent flashes the board, reads the log and debugs on its own, and you approve what it does.
uart_title: UART waveform of the command AT+GMR followed by CR LF, 8N1
uart_caption: AT+GMR\r\n on the wire: start bit, eight data bits from the least significant, stop bit. This is what SerialBot passes to the agent, and nothing else.
loop_title: The debug loop, without you in the middle
loop_intro: Today a person relays the log: flash the board, watch the terminal, copy the interesting lines into the chat, explain what happened. SerialBot lets the agent go around the loop itself.
loop_steps: Flash. The agent hands the port to your flashing tool and takes it back afterwards. The log keeps going.
Read the log. It waits for the line it expects, or notices the timeout.
Change the code. It adds the prints it needs, or the fix.
Build and flash again. Round the loop until the log says it works.
loop_note: You stay in charge: every change the agent wants to make to a port is shown to you first, and every line it sent is tagged AI in the window.

features.Connect: Many ports at once, TCP client and server, UDP, auto-reconnect after replugging.
features.Receive: Text or HEX with millisecond timestamps, ANSI colors, GBK and other encodings, frame gaps, search and filter, keyword highlight, line numbers and bookmarks.
features.Terminal mode: A full terminal emulator on any session: log in to a Linux board, run top or vi.
features.Send: Multi-line text or HEX, checksums (CRC-8/16/32, XOR, SUM, LRC), timed send, command lists, files.
features.Signals: DTR and RTS switches, line lamps, BREAK, timed sequences such as a reset pulse.
features.Small: About 4.5 MB to install on Windows, or a single portable exe. Linux x64 and arm64, macOS universal.
